title: Vesper and the Letters
author: Paloma Kavanagh
blurb: Marguerite Okafor, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the festival ends.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
